title: 1RB1LF_1LC1RB_1LF1LD_1LE0RD_1LB---_1LA0LA: 42,000 eater phases, no event before wall visit 10^(8.7·10^146)
text: With cached transitions between eater phases the level-stripping accelerator runs about 5 phases a second. 42,000 phases in 233 descents (fuels shrinking by about 2 per phase) pass without a right-end event, which puts the next event, and so any halt, beyond wall visit 10<sup>8.73·10<sup>146</sup></sup>. The bottom of the tape refills its fuels as fast as the descents use them, so reaching the event needs a rule one level up.
